corrections.name: Ambassador
corrections.reason: Ambassador is an Attack card; the snapshot lists only Action.
evidence: https://github.com/cypressf/dominion cards.csv lists Action and Attack
https://github.com/mressler/RanDominion dominionCards.js lists isAction and isAttack
Card image (Rio Grande Games, 2009 print) shows the type line 'Action - Attack'

corrections.name: Death Cart
corrections.reason: Death Cart is an Action - Looter card; the snapshot lists only Action, so it would not be recognised as needing a Ruins pile.
evidence: Card image (Rio Grande Games, 2012 print) shows the type line 'Action-Looter' and 'When you gain this, gain 2 Ruins'
https://www.dominiondeck.com card list shows action looter
https://github.com/mressler/RanDominion dominionCards.js marks Death Cart isLooter

corrections.name: Island
corrections.reason: Island is an Action - Victory card; the snapshot lists only Victory.
evidence: https://github.com/cypressf/dominion cards.csv lists Action and Victory
https://github.com/mressler/RanDominion dominionCards.js lists isAction and isVictory
Card image (Rio Grande Games, 2009 print) shows the type line 'Action - Victory'

corrections.name: Miser
corrections.reason: Miser is a plain Action card (it uses the Tavern mat but is not a Reserve card); the snapshot lists Reserve as well.
evidence: Card image (Rio Grande Games, 2015 print) shows the type line 'Action'
https://www.dominiondeck.com card list shows action only
